### Comment by [@PannagaRao](https://github.com/PannagaRao) — 2026-05-30T21:01:17Z

> > > Sorry I thought the large diff was because it was on top of PD.
> > > I realize it's because we bring in a large depencency. Can we look into ways to not need to vendor DRA-example-driver.
> > 
> > 
> > We actually don't need to vendor DRA-example-driver at all. I'm even importing a package which isn't used in the code just to keep the module in go mod file.
> > Following this to get the value of DRA_EXAMPLE_DRIVER_VERSION using go list instead of passing the hard coded value since that is the pattern followed. Thoughts?
> 
> One option could be to move this to hack/tools and use that to grab version if you don't want to hard code version
> 
> But you do import flags from DRA-example driver. I think that's why the vendor list grows so much.

I'm importing flags only to keep the module pinned in go.mod — it's not used in code. Without it, go mod tidy removes the module and go list -m can't resolve the version.

Currently DRA_EXAMPLE_DRIVER_VERSION uses go list -m against the main go.mod, which is why we need the module there. I'll move it to hack/ools/go.mod. That should prevent the vendoring altogether.

<details>
<summary>📝 Walkthrough</summary>

## Walkthrough

This PR adds comprehensive end-to-end testing for DRA partitionable GPU devices by introducing an extended test suite, updating the DRA example driver dependency to v0.3.0 in hack/tools, refactoring build infrastructure to support the new tests, and migrating existing tests from vendor constants to local driver name references.

## Changes

**Extended DRA Partitionable Devices E2E Testing**

| Layer / File(s) | Summary |
|---|---|
| **Dependency updates for DRA v0.3.0** <br> `Makefile-deps.mk`, `go.mod`, `hack/tools/go.mod`, `hack/tools/pinversion.go`, `vendor/modules.txt` | Driver version is now resolved from `hack/tools` context; root `go.mod` removes v0.2.1 direct dependency; `hack/tools/go.mod` adds v0.3.0 and updates indirect Kubernetes, gRPC, and gRPC-related dependencies. |
| **Build infrastructure for extended testing** <br> `Makefile-test.mk`, `hack/testing/e2e-common.sh` | New `test-e2e-dra-extended` Make target runs extended DRA tests with `DRA_GPU_PARTITIONS=4`; e2e infrastructure enables `DRAPartitionableDevices` feature gate, branches manifest selection on `E2E_TARGET_FOLDER`, and extends Helm invocation with optional GPU partition settings. |
| **Extended test environment configuration** <br> `test/e2e/config/dra/extended/*` | Controller manager config enables `KueueDRAIntegration` and partitionable devices feature gates, defines `gpu.memory` device class mappings with counter source and CEL device selector, and applies deployment overrides via kustomization and patch. |
| **Extended DRA partitionable devices test suite** <br> `test/e2e/dra/extended/suite_test.go`, `test/e2e/dra/extended/dra_test.go` | Adds test scaffold that waits for Kueue and DRA driver availability, then runs scenarios validating single/multi-partition GPU requests with quota charging, MAX selector matching, full-GPU allocation, combined claim types, quota exhaustion, concurrent workload admission, and CEL selector inadmissibility. |
| **Baseline and multi-kueue test migration** <br> `test/e2e/dra/baseline/dra_test.go`, `test/e2e/multikueue/dra/dra_test.go` | Removes vendor `draconsts` import and replaces all `draconsts.DriverName` references with local `driverName` constant across device request and CEL selector expressions. |

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 3 (Moderate) | ⏱️ ~20 minutes

## Poem

> 🐰 A new test suite hops into the meadow,  
> GPU partitions charged by quota's shadow,  
> Vendor constants packed away with care,  
> DRA extended features blooming fair!  
> The baseline trails now unified stand,  
> While v0.3.0 drives the promised land. 🚀
